name: Khoai nuong
summary: Khoai nướng is grilled sweet potato, a plain night snack beside the corn.
origin: Vinh. The 24 November 2022 city page gives it its own stop. The 28 April 2023 page puts it on Đào Tấn.
howToEat: Order it at night with the corn. The city page does not say how it is grilled or what is on it. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Đào Tấn mobile kiosks on the 28 April 2023 account, 18:00–06:00 on the 27 April 2023 account. The 24 November 2022 page does not name a street. A 2026 night list was not opened.
